dog.description_text:
Leonard is a 3-year-old mixed breed weighing around 23 pounds, and he just might be the cutest tripod you'll ever meet. Missing a leg doesn't slow him down one bit. He gets around beautifully and approaches life with a sweet, easygoing attitude that makes him incredibly easy to love.

Leonard is a smart, gentle guy who seems to take most things in stride. He's house-trained, and crate-trained. He loves to get attention and being the star of your life. He needs a bit of time to warm up to new dogs, but after a thoughtful introduction, he's happy to share a home with another canine sibling. That being said, he'd prefer a home without cats.

What really stands out about Leonard is how kind and affectionate he is. He's the sort of dog who quietly wins people over with his sweet nature and good manners. If you're looking for a loyal companion with a heart as big as his smile, Leonard is ready to meet you.

Registered adopters interested in Leonard can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, you can do it today at hbrdogs.com.
